oci_mitre_attack_027.display_name: OCI-MITRE-ATTACK-027: MITRE T1687: Exploitation for Defense Impairment
oci_mitre_attack_027.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1687 (Exploitation for Defense Impairment). Adversaries may exploit vulnerabilities in security software, infrastructure, or defensive components to degrade, disable, or otherwise continue to impair their ability to prevent, detect, or respond
